title: Verify-then-read cannot silently re-enter
note: D-2026-76. The static guard walks every production file for a raw read, a tail parse, a resurrected read_from, or the file opened directly; the runtime guard refuses the raw parse to any qta_agent caller but the events module. Each mutation removes one rule, widens the scope or allowlist, or removes the runtime half.

mutations.name: VG1_a_raw_read_is_not_flagged
mutations.rationale: THE rule: verify-then-read re-enters through the one method it goes through

mutations.name: VG2_an_alias_escapes
mutations.rationale: x = self.log; x.read() -- the first thing a refactor produces

mutations.name: VG3_iteration_is_not_a_read
mutations.rationale: for ev in self.log is read() under another name

mutations.name: VG4_the_tail_parser_is_not_flagged
mutations.rationale: verify_from followed by a second tail parse, the advance() defect

mutations.name: VG5_read_from_may_come_back
mutations.rationale: the removed unverified-tail primitive is redefined and nothing notices

mutations.name: VG6_opening_the_file_is_not_a_read
mutations.rationale: stepping around the EventLog API entirely

mutations.name: VG7_everything_is_allowlisted
mutations.rationale: the allowlist stops being per-site: any violation is absorbed by the one reason given for the fuzz target

mutations.name: VG8_tools_are_not_scanned
mutations.rationale: the scope narrows to where violations are not expected to be

mutations.name: VG9_a_stale_allowlist_is_kept
mutations.rationale: an allowlist entry for a site that no longer exists stays, ready to absorb the next one

mutations.name: VG10_the_runtime_refusal_is_removed
mutations.rationale: D-2026-76: the refusal an alias cannot evade is gone, and only the name-based scan remains

mutations.name: VG11_iteration_skips_the_runtime_refusal
mutations.rationale: the events module becomes the caller of read(), so iterating the log from a reducer is allowed

mutations.name: VG12_a_nameless_caller_crashes_the_guard
mutations.rationale: D-2026-79: exec'd code with __name__ = None (a Snakemake rule body) crashes the guard instead of being let through
